additional_info.subject: ID0380216-DC/Si-D/PL[170001369] - Coap polling error CRM:00315001800
additional_info.body:
Hi Szymon,
After the DC2 stopped charging, it never left the plug:
This keeps going for a long time, I believe the vehicle is trying BCB toggle and is not able. The problem is not existent, the customer just needs to plug out the cable since the session was finished successfully at 100% SoC.
If you need anything else let me know, otherwise I will close the ticket.
Best regards,
Francisco
